subject: english
question: Someone who dislike men is called.
solution:
**The correct answer is: Option 1) Misandrist.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Misandrist** refers to someone who dislikes or is prejudiced against men. (पुरुषों से घृणा करने वाला)

 
 
• **Example:** Her views were often criticized for being misandrist.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Misandrist**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their meanings:

 
• **Misogynist** (स्त्री द्वेषी): Someone who dislikes, despises, or is strongly prejudiced against women.

 
 
• **Example:** His remarks were deemed misogynist by many critics.
 
 
 
• **Philanthropist** (परमार्थी): A person who seeks to promote the welfare of others, especially by the generous donation of money to good causes.
 
 
• **Example:** The philanthropist donated millions to support education initiatives.
 
 
 
• **Manuscript** (हस्तलेख): A handwritten or typed document, especially a writer's original text before it is printed.
 
 
• **Example:** She submitted her manuscript to several publishers.
 
 

45:T915,

The correct answer is** option 1.**
